units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:1">M. Kat. III, 1</cite> <he>ואלו מְכַבְּסִין במועד</he> and these are permitted to wash their clothes during the festive week.

<cite ref="Taanit 29b:9">Taan. 29ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 18a">M. Kat. 18ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מותר לְכַבְּסוֹ וכ׳</he> is permitted to wash it; a. fr.—Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 61ᵇ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> (play on <he>כבשים</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 28:3">Num. XXVIII, 3</cite>) <he>שהם מְכַבְּסִים וכ׳</he> for they (as sacrifices) wash (cleanse) the sins of Israel.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוּבָּס</he>, f. <he>מְכוּבֶּסֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְכוּבָּסִין</he>; <he>מְכוּבָּסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:4">Mikv. X, 4</cite> <he>בגדים שהטבילן מכ׳</he> garments immersed while still wet from washing.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite> (play on <he>שלמה</he>) [reads:] <he>מה שַׂלְמָה זו מתלכלכת ומִתְכַּבֶּסֶת וכ׳</he> as a garment is soiled and washed again &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982">Yalk. ib. 982</cite>. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 10 (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 49:11">Gen. XLIX, 11</cite>) <he>אם יטעו בהלכה תהא מתכבסת בתחומו וכ׳</he> when they err in a decision, it shall be cleansed (atoned for) in his (Judah’s) dominion (the Temple); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:8">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> (not <he>מתכסום</he>).
